metadata.case_name: TONG CHUN CHUNG v. PUD CHI KEUNG

injuries.description: 4 cm laceration to the left side of his head
source: the plaintiff was fully conscious and was diagnosed to have suffered a 4 cm laceration to the left side of his head as well as tenderness and bruising over the right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

source: The medical diagnosis was head contusion with scalp laceration and right shoulder contusion.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

source: He was diagnosed to have post-concussional syndrome ("PCS").
The medical diagnosis was head contusion with scalp laceration and right shoulder contusion.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: bilateral sensorineural hearing loss at 4 KHz to 60 dB
source: Hearing tests showed that he suffered from bilateral sensorineural hearing loss at 4 KHz to 60 dB. The hearing threshold at other range was around 30 dB. He was prescribed with hearing aid in the left ear.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

manifestations.description: Possible brief loss of consciousness for several minutes after impact
Impaired memory and difficulty concentrating; poor performance in cognitive tasks and executive function
Personality change: easily irritable and poor temper control
Depressed mood, low self-esteem, insomnia, decreased appetite and fleeting suicidal ideas
Paraesthesiae and dull aches in his limbs; complaints of numbness and weakness in all four limbs
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss (worse in the left ear); required a hearing aid in the left ear
Walked with a stick and required the assistance of his wife; needs to be accompanied when venturing out
Tenderness and decreased sensation and slight reduction of power (4/5) of the right upper limb

losses.description: Daily activity was partially dependant on his wife; needs to be accompanied by his wife when he ventures out of the home.
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss at 4 KHz to 60 dB; was prescribed a hearing aid in the left ear.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life

losses.description: Tenderness, bruising and contusion of the right shoulder with decreased sensation and slight reduction of power of the right upper limb.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Needs to be accompanied by his wife when he ventures out of the home.
Impaired concentration, registering and memorising information and executive function as found on clinical cognitive tests.
